dedupe_keys.name: warsaw bike sharing stations dataset raw season 2023

description: Warsaw Bike-Sharing Stations Dataset (RAW) - Season 2023 is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Igor Betkier. This dataset contains information about Warsaw’s bikesharing system, collected every five minutes between May 6 and November 29, 2023. The data cover various aspects of the system, including detailed records of bike trips, station attributes (e.g., distances to points of interest), and station snapshots (number of available bikes, bike IDs, etc.). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
